The nineteenth season of the One Piece anime series was produced by Toei Animation , and directed by Toshinori Fukuzawa . The season began broadcasting in Japan on Fuji Television on April 9 , 2017 . Like the rest of the series , it follows the adventures of Monkey D. Luffy and his Straw Hat Pirates . The story arc , called `` Whole Cake Island '' , adapts material from the rest of the 82nd volume onwards of the manga by Eiichiro Oda . It deals with Luffy and his small team rescuing Sanji from his arranged marriage to finalize a political alliance between his own family , the Vinsmoke 's , and Big Mom 's family .
